column3: NASB adds “yet” and renders “perch” as “nest”; the Old Testament phrases are in capitals.
NASB renders “since He was in the boat” as “in the boat, just as He was.”
“A violent storm of wind” is rendered “a fierce gale of wind.”
“Having been awoken” is rendered “got up”; “a great calm” is “perfectly calm.”
NASB follows the critical text (“Do you still have no faith?”).
“Feared a great fear” is rendered “became very much afraid.”
